task: Fix issue 4752 by making vendor portability validation unconditional for whole-tree checks

events.content: Read issue 4752, its comments, and linked issue and PR discussions. Verified no open PR already addresses the issue.
Reproduced the defect on current origin/main: the whole-tree validation job depended on dorny path-filter output and a skip job could report success without a measurement.

Removed the change-detector and skip jobs so one validation job runs for push, pull_request, and workflow_dispatch. Updated structural tests to pin every validator command, unconditional job wiring, triggers, and absence of filters.

Proved the tests fail against the old filtered workflow, a deleted-validator mutant, and an event-level paths-ignore mutant. Ran 11 focused tests, all six validators, security review, and a full local gh act push execution successfully.
